title: NPS Vatsalya — How to apply
text:
- Open online on the eNPS platform of NPS Trust (npstrust.org.in) or through the online service of a Point of Presence.
- Or visit a Point of Presence registered with PFRDA, such as a bank, India Post or a pension fund.
- When opening the account, the guardian chooses a Central Recordkeeping Agency and a pension fund. Parents, relatives and friends can then pay in by cash, cheque or online.
- At 18, the young person must complete fresh KYC and give nominee details before any withdrawal or change is allowed.

title: NPS Vatsalya — Documents needed
text:
- Proof of the child's date of birth: birth certificate, school leaving certificate, matriculation certificate, PAN or passport.
- Guardian's identity and address proof (KYC): Aadhaar, driving licence, passport, voter ID, NREGA job card or National Population Register document.
- Guardian's PAN, or Form 60.
- Copy of the court order, if a court-appointed legal guardian opens the account.
- For NRI/OCI guardians: the minor's own or joint NRE/NRO bank account.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Overview
aliases: pradhan mantri kisan samman nidhi yojana
text:
Gives Rs 6,000 a year, paid as three instalments of Rs 2,000, directly into the bank accounts of farmer families who own cultivable land. Families with a better-off member, such as income tax payers, government employees or pensioners getting Rs 10,000 or more a month, are left out.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare).

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Eligibility rules (part 1 of 2)
aliases: pradhan mantri kisan samman nidhi yojana
text:
- Your family must own cultivable land, and the names must be entered in the state or UT land records.
- For this scheme a farmer family means husband, wife and minor children.
- There is no upper limit on land size; the original 2-hectare cap was dropped when the scheme was opened to all landholding farmer families.
- Eligibility is judged on land ownership recorded as on 01.02.2019; land received later by inheritance after the owner's death still counts, but land bought or gifted after that date does not make the new owner eligible.
- An Aadhaar number and a bank account seeded with Aadhaar are compulsory.
- e-KYC must be completed before payments are released.
- In some North-Eastern states and in Jharkhand, land certificates from village authorities or verified lineage records are accepted where regular land records do not exist.
Not eligible:
- Institutional landholders, and (for newly added beneficiaries) Non-Resident Indians as defined under the Income Tax Act.
- Families where any member holds or has held a constitutional post, or is or was a Union or State minister, MP, MLA, MLC, mayor of a municipal corporation or chairperson of a district panchayat.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Eligibility rules (part 2 of 2)
aliases: pradhan mantri kisan samman nidhi yojana
text:
- Families where any member is a serving or retired officer or employee of the Central or State Government, a central or state PSU or a government autonomous body, or a regular employee of a local body; Multi Tasking Staff, Class IV and Group D staff are not excluded.
- Families with a retired pensioner whose monthly pension is Rs 10,000 or more (Multi Tasking Staff, Class IV and Group D pensioners are not excluded).
- Families where any member paid income tax in the last assessment year.
- Families with a practising professional registered with a professional body: doctor, engineer, lawyer, chartered accountant or architect.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Benefits
aliases: pradhan mantri kisan samman nidhi yojana
text:
- Rs 6,000 per year for each eligible farmer family.
- The money comes in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 each, one every four months (April-July, August-November and December-March).
- Payments go by Direct Benefit Transfer straight into the family's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
- The Central Government bears the full cost; the farmer pays nothing.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — How to apply
aliases: pradhan mantri kisan samman nidhi yojana
text:
- Register yourself on the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or the PM-KISAN mobile app, or get help at a Common Service Centre (CSC).
- The state government checks your land records and the exclusion rules before your name is approved; beneficiary lists are displayed at village level.
- Complete e-KYC by OTP, fingerprint (biometric) or face authentication in the PM-KISAN app.
- If you are eligible but left out, raise a complaint on the PM-KISAN portal or CPGRAMS, or approach the district grievance committee.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Documents needed
aliases: pradhan mantri kisan samman nidhi yojana
text:
- Aadhaar card.
- Bank account number and IFSC of an account linked to Aadhaar.
- Land record details of the family's cultivable land.
- Mobile number for SMS alerts and OTP-based e-KYC.
- Self-declaration that no family member falls in an excluded category, with consent for Aadhaar-based checks.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) — Overview
text:
A voluntary pension plan for small and marginal farmers (land up to 2 hectares) who join between ages 18 and 40. The farmer pays Rs 55 to Rs 200 a month, the Central Government adds the same amount, and from age 60 the farmer gets a guaranteed pension of at least Rs 3,000 a month.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare); pension fund managed by LIC.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) — Eligibility rules (part 1 of 2)
text:
- Small or marginal farmer who owns cultivable land of up to 2 hectares as per state or UT land records.
- Aged 18 to 40 years at the time of joining.
- Name must appear in the state or UT land records as on 01.08.2019.
- Both men and women farmers can join, in any state or union territory.
- Must agree to pay a monthly contribution of Rs 55 to Rs 200, depending on age at joining, until age 60.
Not eligible:
- Farmers already covered by another statutory social security scheme such as NPS, ESIC or an EPFO scheme.
- Farmers who have joined PM Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) or PM Laghu Vyapari Maan-Dhan (PM-LVM).
- Institutional landholders, and present or former holders of constitutional posts, Union or State ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, mayors of municipal corporations and district panchayat chairpersons.
- Serving or retired officers and employees of Central or State Government, PSUs and government autonomous bodies, and regular local body employees (Multi Tasking Staff, Class IV and Group D are not excluded).
- Anyone who paid income tax in the last assessment year.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) — Eligibility rules (part 2 of 2)
text: - Practising professionals registered with a professional body: doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) — Benefits
text:
- From age 60, a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs 3,000 a month.
- The Central Government puts in a matching amount equal to the farmer's own contribution.
- Monthly contribution ranges from Rs 55 (joining at 18) to Rs 200 (joining at 40); for example Rs 100 if joining at 29.
- If the pensioner dies, the spouse gets a family pension of half the pension, i.e. Rs 1,500 a month, provided the spouse is not already a member.
- If the member dies before 60, the spouse can keep paying and continue the account, or take back the member's contributions with interest.
- Leaving within 10 years returns your own contributions with savings bank interest; leaving after 10 years but before 60 returns them with fund interest or savings bank interest, whichever is higher.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) — How to apply
text:
- Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC); the village level entrepreneur registers you online and you pay the first contribution there. Registration is free.
- You can also enrol through the State or UT nodal officer for PM-KISAN, or online on the scheme portal (pmkmy.gov.in).
- Monthly contributions are auto-debited from your bank account; you may sign a mandate to pay them out of your PM-KISAN instalments instead.
- After enrolment you receive a PM-KMY pension card with a unique Pension Account Number.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar card.
- Bank passbook or bank account details (account number and IFSC).
- Mobile number for OTP verification (optional but advised).
- Date of birth and spouse and nominee details.

title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY) — Overview
aliases: प्रधानमंत्री सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
PM Surya Ghar free electricity scheme
Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme Phase II
text:
Gives households a central subsidy of up to Rs 78,000 to put grid-connected solar panels on their roof. The aim is up to 300 units of free or low-cost electricity a month. The scheme is set to run until 31 March 2027.
Central government scheme. Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.

title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY) — Eligibility rules
aliases: प्रधानमंत्री सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
PM Surya Ghar free electricity scheme
Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme Phase II
text:
- Must be a residential electricity consumer with a valid consumer account number from the local electricity distribution company (DISCOM).
- The solar plant must be grid-connected and linked to that household's residential power connection.
- Panels must be on a roof, terrace or balcony, or on an elevated structure (ground-mounted elevated structures are allowed).
- The system must be installed by a vendor registered on the PM Surya Ghar National Portal.
- Solar modules must be made in India from Indian-made cells (Domestic Content Requirement).
- Group housing societies and RWAs can get the subsidy for common facilities, including EV charging, up to 500 kW, counted at 3 kW per house.
Not eligible:
- Non-residential connections such as government, commercial and industrial users get no subsidy.
- Off-grid systems that are not connected to the grid are not eligible.
- Systems using imported (non-DCR) solar modules are not eligible.
- A system that is shifted to a new location cannot get the subsidy again; it is given only once per installation.
- A home that already got a central rooftop solar subsidy can claim only for added capacity, up to 3 kW in total.

title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY) — Benefits
aliases: प्रधानमंत्री सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
PM Surya Ghar free electricity scheme
Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme Phase II
text:
- Central subsidy of Rs 30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW, so a 2 kW system gets Rs 60,000.
- Rs 18,000 for the third kW and no extra subsidy beyond 3 kW, so the maximum central subsidy is Rs 78,000.
- In special category areas (Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, J&K, Ladakh, North-Eastern states including Sikkim, Andaman and Nicobar, Lakshadweep) the rates are Rs 33,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and Rs 19,800 for the third kW.
- The scheme aims to help households get up to 300 units of free or low-cost electricity a month from their own panels.
- Registered vendors must repair and maintain the system free of cost for 5 years from commissioning.
- Low-interest bank loans (about repo rate plus 0.5 per cent) are planned for systems up to 3 kW and can be chosen through the National Portal.

title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY) — How to apply
aliases: प्रधानमंत्री सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
PM Surya Ghar free electricity scheme
Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme Phase II
text:
- Register on the National Portal pmsuryaghar.gov.in using your DISCOM consumer account number, then choose a vendor registered on the portal.
- After the vendor installs the system, upload the system details and geo-tagged photos on the portal; the DISCOM then inspects the system and fits the net meter.
- After DISCOM approval, the subsidy is released to your bank account (or loan account) and is meant to be processed within 15 days.

title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY) — Documents needed
aliases: प्रधानमंत्री सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
PM Surya Ghar free electricity scheme
Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme Phase II
text:
- Electricity consumer account number (from your electricity bill).
- Bank account details with a cancelled cheque, passbook or bank statement.
- Geo-tagged photos and other installation details uploaded on the portal after installation.
- Loan account details, if the system is paid for with a bank loan.

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) (PM SVANidhi) — Overview
aliases: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
text:
PM SVANidhi gives street vendors working capital loans without collateral in three steps: up to Rs 15,000, then Rs 25,000, then Rs 50,000. It also gives a 7% interest subsidy, cashback on digital payments and a RuPay credit card for vendors who repay well. New loans can be given until 31 March 2030 under the restructured scheme.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (with Department of Financial Services).

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) (PM SVANidhi) — Eligibility rules
aliases: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
text:
- Must be a street vendor who sells goods or services to the public on streets, footpaths or other public places, from a temporary stall or by moving from place to place; seasonal or year-round, mobile or stationary.
- Must be an adult aged 18 years or above; there is no upper age limit.
- Vendors in cities and towns must hold a Certificate of Vending (CoV), Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) issued by the Urban Local Body or Town Vending Committee.
- Vendors in census towns and peri-urban areas must have an LoR approved by the Block Development Officer (BDO).
- The 2nd and 3rd loans are given only after the previous loan is fully repaid.
- For the credit card only: must have repaid the 2nd loan and be eligible for or have taken the 3rd loan, and be aged 21 to 65 years.
Not eligible:
- People below 18 years of age.
- A lender may refuse the loan if the applicant has an existing loan classified as NPA or written off by any lender (a low credit score alone is not a reason to refuse).
- Manually issued LoRs are not valid; the LoR must be issued through the PM SVANidhi portal.

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) (PM SVANidhi) — Benefits
aliases: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
text:
- Working capital loans without collateral in three tranches: 1st loan of up to Rs 15,000 (repay in 12 months), 2nd loan of up to Rs 25,000 (repay in 18 months) and 3rd loan of up to Rs 50,000 (repay in 36 months).
- Interest subsidy of 7% per year, credited to the borrower's account every quarter; for example, up to Rs 603 on a Rs 15,000 first loan repaid on time.
- Cashback on digital transactions: Rs 1 per transaction, up to Rs 100 a month and up to Rs 1,200 a year in each tranche.
- Extra cashback of up to Rs 100 a quarter (maximum Rs 400 a year) for digital wholesale purchases of at least Rs 2,000.
- No processing fee on the 1st and 2nd loans, no margin money, no guarantee fee and no penalty for early repayment.
- A lifetime-free, UPI-linked RuPay credit card with a limit of up to Rs 30,000 (starting at Rs 10,000), valid for 5 years.

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) (PM SVANidhi) — How to apply
aliases: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
text:
- Apply online on the PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or the PM SVANidhi mobile app; new loans can be given until 31 March 2030.
- Vendors without a CoV or ID card submit a 'LoR cum loan application'; the ULB or Block office verifies it and issues the LoR digitally, and the loan request then goes to the chosen bank.
- Help is available at ULB offices, Block offices, Common Service Centres (CSCs) and from resource persons appointed by ULBs.
- Linking your mobile number with Aadhaar is advised for smooth processing.

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) (PM SVANidhi) — Documents needed
aliases: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
text:
- Certificate of Vending, Identity Card or LoR from the ULB/Town Vending Committee, or LoR approved by the BDO.
- Aadhaar card (Voter ID only for vendors from Assam and Meghalaya who do not have Aadhaar).
- Savings bank account passbook or bank statement.
- A valid UPI ID linked to the vendor's bank account.
- For the credit card: PAN card as well.

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) — Overview
text:
A voluntary pension scheme for unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 who earn Rs 15,000 a month or less. The worker pays a small monthly amount, the government pays the same amount, and the worker gets a pension of at least Rs 3,000 a month from age 60.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Labour and Employment.

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Works in the unorganised sector, for example as a street vendor, domestic worker, rickshaw puller, head loader, construction or farm labourer, beedi, handloom or leather worker, or in similar work.
- Aged 18 to 40 when joining.
- Monthly income of Rs 15,000 or less.
- Has an Aadhaar card and a savings bank or Jan Dhan account with IFSC.
Not eligible:
- People older than 40 cannot join.
- Members of EPFO, ESIC or NPS (organised-sector coverage) cannot join.
- Income tax payers cannot join.
- People already getting benefits from another government pension scheme are not eligible, according to the PIB note on the scheme.

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) — Benefits
text:
- A minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month for life from age 60.
- The worker pays Rs 55 to Rs 200 a month depending on age at joining (Rs 55 at 18, Rs 105 at 30, Rs 200 at 40) until age 60, and the Central Government adds an equal amount every month.
- If the pensioner dies, the spouse gets 50% of the pension as family pension; family pension is only for the spouse.
- If the member dies before 60 after paying regularly, the spouse can continue the scheme and later get the pension, or take back the member's contribution with interest.
- Leaving within 10 years returns the worker's own contribution with savings bank interest; leaving after 10 years but before 60 returns it with the interest earned by the fund or savings bank interest, whichever is higher.

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) — How to apply
text:
- Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and bank account details, or self-enrol on the official portal maandhan.in.
- The first contribution is paid in cash at the CSC; after that it is auto-debited from the bank account each month (quarterly, half-yearly or yearly payment is also possible).
- A Shram Yogi pension card and account number are given after enrolment; enrolment is free.
- Helpline: 14434 or 1800 2676 888.

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar card.
- Savings bank or Jan Dhan account details with IFSC.
- Mobile number.
- Self-certification form and consent for auto-debit; no separate proof of age or income is required.

title: PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS) — Overview
aliases: pradhan mantri uchchatar shiksha protsahan yojana
central sector scholarship for college students
text:
A Ministry of Education merit-cum-means scholarship for students who scored above the 80th percentile in their Class 12 board exam and whose family income is up to Rs 4.5 lakh a year. It pays Rs 12,000 a year for the first three years of college and Rs 20,000 a year at postgraduate level, and also in the 4th and 5th years of longer professional courses.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Education, Department of Higher Education.

title: PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS) — Eligibility rules
aliases: pradhan mantri uchchatar shiksha protsahan yojana
central sector scholarship for college students
text:
- You passed Class 12 (10+2 or equivalent) and scored above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in your stream in your board's exam.
- Your name must be in the merit list that your board (State board, CBSE or CISCE) shares on the National Scholarship Portal.
- Gross parental or family income of up to Rs 4,50,000 (4.5 lakh) a year.
- Fresh applicants must have passed Class 12 in the previous academic year and joined the first year of a regular degree course.
- Your college or institution must be recognised by AICTE or the relevant regulatory body and have a valid AISHE code.
- You must not be getting any other merit scholarship, state scholarship, fee waiver or fee reimbursement.
- To renew each year you need at least 50% marks in the annual exam and at least 75% attendance.
Not eligible:
- Students in correspondence or distance-mode courses.
- Students doing diploma courses.
- Students who took a gap (drop) year after Class 12.
- Students already receiving another scholarship, fee waiver or fee reimbursement.
- Students facing complaints of indiscipline, criminal behaviour or ragging lose the scholarship.

title: PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS) — Benefits
aliases: pradhan mantri uchchatar shiksha protsahan yojana
central sector scholarship for college students
text:
- Rs 12,000 a year for the first three years of graduation in college and university courses.
- Rs 20,000 a year at postgraduate level.
- In five-year or integrated professional courses, Rs 20,000 a year in the 4th and 5th years.
- B.Tech or B.E. students get Rs 12,000 a year for years 1 to 3 and Rs 20,000 in the 4th year.
- The scholarship is renewed year by year, for a total of no more than 5 years.
- Up to 82,000 fresh scholarships a year, half of them for girls, paid by DBT into the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

title: PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS) — How to apply
aliases: pradhan mantri uchchatar shiksha protsahan yojana
central sector scholarship for college students
text:
- Create a One Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) using Aadhaar and the mobile number linked to it.
- Log in, choose your domicile state and the Post-Matric option, select the PM-USP Central Sector Scheme, fill the form and upload documents. Applying is free.
- Your college (institute nodal officer) verifies the application first, then the state nodal agency.
- Apply for renewal on NSP every year before the deadline. If you miss one year, you can apply for renewal the next year if you still qualify.

title: PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS) — Documents needed
aliases: pradhan mantri uchchatar shiksha protsahan yojana
central sector scholarship for college students
text:
- Class 12 mark sheet (fresh applicants).
- Family income certificate (needed only for fresh applicants).
- Caste or category certificate for reserved-category students.
- Disability certificate, if applicable.
- Previous year's mark sheet (for renewal).
- Aadhaar number and an Aadhaar-seeded bank account in the student's own name.

title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY) — Overview
text:
People who start their first EPF-covered job between 1 August 2025 and 31 July 2027 and earn up to Rs 1,00,000 a month get a one-time incentive. It equals one month's EPF wage, up to Rs 15,000, and is paid in two instalments. Employers separately get incentives for adding new jobs.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Labour and Employment (implemented through EPFO).

title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Joined an establishment covered by EPF between 1 August 2025 and 31 July 2027 (both dates included).
- Is a first-time EPF member, meaning they never contributed to EPF with EPFO or an exempted PF trust before 1 August 2025.
- Has a gross monthly salary of up to Rs 1,00,000 at the time of joining, counting all emoluments.
- Has worked at least 6 completed months in the same establishment (needed for the first instalment).
- Has worked 12 completed months in the same establishment and finished the free online financial literacy course (needed for the second instalment).
- Has a UAN and a bank account seeded with Aadhaar.
Not eligible:
- Anyone who contributed to EPF, with EPFO or an exempted trust, before 1 August 2025 is not a first-timer and cannot get the incentive.
- Employees whose gross monthly salary is above Rs 1,00,000 at joining are not covered.
- Anyone who leaves the job before 6 completed months gets no first instalment.
- Anyone who leaves between 6 and 12 months does not get the second instalment.

title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY) — Benefits
text:
- A one-time incentive equal to one month's EPF wage, up to a maximum of Rs 15,000.
- Paid in 2 instalments. The first comes after 6 months of service. The second comes after 12 months of service and completion of the financial literacy course.
- The second instalment is kept in a savings or deposit account for a period to be set in later guidelines.
- Paid by DBT through the Aadhaar Bridge Payment System into the employee's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
- Separately, employers get up to Rs 3,000 per month for each additional employee. This lasts 2 years in all sectors and 4 years in manufacturing.

title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY) — How to apply
text:
- Employees do not need to apply or register. The incentive is worked out from the monthly PF return (ECR) that the employer files.
- Get a UAN through the employer, or generate it yourself using face authentication on the UMANG app.
- Make sure your bank account is seeded with Aadhaar. Payment is held back until it is.
- Before completing 12 months, finish the free financial literacy course on the EPFO website. Helpline: 14480 or 1800-180-1850 (toll-free).

title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY) — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar number.
- Universal Account Number (UAN).
- Bank account seeded with Aadhaar.

title: PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi) (PM-Vidyalaxmi) — Overview
text:
Bank education loans with no collateral and no guarantor for students admitted to quality higher education institutions identified by the government. Loans up to Rs 7.5 lakh carry a 75% government credit guarantee, and students from families earning up to Rs 8 lakh a year can get 3% interest subvention. The Union Cabinet approved the scheme on 6 November 2024, and students apply on the PM-Vidyalaxmi portal.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education), with the Department of Financial Services.

title: PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi) (PM-Vidyalaxmi) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Has secured admission in a Quality Higher Educational Institution (QHEI) identified by the Ministry of Education.
- Admission should be on merit, for example through a recognised entrance exam or the merit quota.
- To get the 3% interest subvention, annual family income must be Rs 8 lakh or less, and the subvention applies to loans up to Rs 10 lakh.
- The 3% interest subvention is limited to 1 lakh students a year, chosen in this order of preference: admission to a government institution, then technical/professional courses, then students who passed Class 12 or Class 10 from a government school, then those who passed Class 12 from a rural school, then girl students.
- Aadhaar is required to get the scheme's benefits, including the loan, interest subvention and credit guarantee.
Not eligible:
- Education loans for admissions under management quota are not eligible.

title: PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi) (PM-Vidyalaxmi) — Benefits
text:
- Education loans without any collateral and without a guarantor, from scheduled commercial banks, regional rural banks and cooperative banks.
- Loans up to Rs 7.5 lakh carry a 75% credit guarantee from the Government of India through NCGTC, which encourages banks to lend.
- Interest subvention of 3% during the moratorium period on loans up to Rs 10 lakh for students whose annual family income is up to Rs 8 lakh.
- Separately, students with annual family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh in professional or technical courses get full interest subvention during the moratorium on loans up to Rs 10 lakh under the existing PM-USP CSIS scheme, also claimed through this portal.
- The interest rate is capped at each bank's External Benchmark Lending Rate (EBLR) plus 0.5%.
- One application can be sent to up to 3 banks at the same time.

title: PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi) (PM-Vidyalaxmi) — How to apply
text:
- Register on pmvidyalaxmi.co.in with your mobile number and email, fill the common two-page education loan form, upload documents and choose up to 3 banks.
- Only one active application is allowed at a time; track its status on the portal. The bank checks the documents and pays the loan amount to the institution.
- After the loan is sanctioned and disbursed, apply for interest subvention on the same portal; for loans disbursed in 2025-26, the claim through the bank starts after 31 March 2026.
- Toll-free helpline: 1800 1031.

title: PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi) (PM-Vidyalaxmi) — Documents needed
text:
- PAN card (when applying for the loan).
- Aadhaar card (before the loan is disbursed).
- Passport-size colour photograph of the student and co-applicant, if needed.
- Marksheets and certificates for Class 10, Class 12, graduation or the last qualifying exam.
- Admission or offer letter with the schedule of expenses.
- Income certificate from a competent government authority (Tehsildar/SDM), needed only if claiming interest subvention.

title: PM Vishwakarma — Overview
text:
Support for self-employed traditional artisans and craftspeople in 18 listed trades: a certificate and ID card, paid skill training, a toolkit incentive of up to Rs 15,000, and collateral-free loans of up to Rs 1 lakh and then Rs 2 lakh at 5% interest.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.

title: PM Vishwakarma — Eligibility rules
text:
- Must work with hands and tools in one of the 18 listed family-based traditional trades: carpenter, boat maker, armourer, blacksmith, hammer and tool kit maker, locksmith, sculptor/stone carver, goldsmith, potter, cobbler/shoesmith, mason, basket/mat/broom maker, doll and toy maker, barber, garland maker, washerman, tailor, or fishing net maker.
- Must be self-employed in the unorganised sector.
- Must be at least 18 years old on the date of registration.
- Must be actually working in the trade on the date of registration.
- Only one member of a family can register; a family means husband, wife and unmarried children.
Not eligible:
- People in government service and their family members cannot apply.
- People who took a loan in the past 5 years under a similar central or state government self-employment or business credit scheme, such as PMEGP, PM SVANidhi or MUDRA, are not eligible.
- According to the portal FAQ, anyone who has taken a PMEGP loan cannot apply, and anyone with an unpaid PM SVANidhi or MUDRA loan cannot apply until it is repaid.

title: PM Vishwakarma — Benefits
text:
- Recognition as a Vishwakarma through a PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card.
- Skill verification followed by 5-7 days (40 hours) of basic training, with optional 15 days (120 hours) of advanced training, and a stipend of Rs 500 per day during training.
- Toolkit incentive of up to Rs 15,000 to buy modern tools.
- First collateral-free loan of up to Rs 1 lakh, repaid over 18 months; a second loan of up to Rs 2 lakh, repaid over 30 months, for those who keep the first loan account regular and have adopted digital transactions or taken advanced training.
- The borrower pays a concessional interest rate of 5%, the Ministry of MSME pays interest subvention capped at 8%, and no guarantee fee is charged.
- Re 1 for each digital transaction, for up to 100 transactions a month, plus marketing support such as quality certification, branding, e-commerce linkage and trade fairs.

title: PM Vishwakarma — How to apply
text:
- Register on the official portal pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
- For help, go to the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), MSME Development and Facilitation Office (MSME-DFO) or District Industries Centre (DIC).
- The application is checked by the local Gram Pradhan or urban local body and by district officials before benefits are given.

title: PM Vishwakarma — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar card.
- Mobile number.
- Bank account details.
- Ration card; if you do not have one, Aadhaar cards of all family members.

title: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs and Others (PM YASASVI) (PM YASASVI) — Overview
aliases: Top Class Education for OBC EBC DNT students
text:
An umbrella scholarship scheme for OBC, EBC and DNT students whose family income is up to Rs 2.5 lakh a year. It covers pre-matric (Class 9-10) and post-matric (Class 11 onward) scholarships run by states, plus full-cost scholarships at notified top class schools and colleges applied for on the National Scholarship Portal.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Backward Classes Division).

title: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs and Others (PM YASASVI) (PM YASASVI) — Eligibility rules (part 1 of 2)
aliases: Top Class Education for OBC EBC DNT students
text:
- Belongs to the OBC, EBC (economically backward class) or DNT (denotified, nomadic or semi-nomadic tribe) category, with a valid certificate.
- EBC and DNT students qualify only if they are not already covered as SC, ST or OBC.
- Parents' or guardians' annual income from all sources must be Rs 2,50,000 or less.
- Indian nationals only.
- Pre-matric part: studying full-time in Class 9 or 10 in a government school.
- Post-matric part: has passed Class 10 or higher and is studying a recognised post-matric course in India (such as Class 11-12, ITI, diploma, graduation or post-graduation).
- Top class school part: studying in Class 9 to 12 at a school notified as a Top Class School; scholarships go by state-wise merit lists, with at least 30% for girls.
- Top class college part: admitted to a full-time course at a notified top class institution (such as an IIT, IIM, AIIMS, NIT or National Law University); scholarships go by merit within each institute's slots, with 30% of slots for girls.
Not eligible:
- Pre-matric and post-matric: only two boys from the same parents can get the scholarship; there is no such limit for girls.

title: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs and Others (PM YASASVI) (PM YASASVI) — Eligibility rules (part 2 of 2)
aliases: Top Class Education for OBC EBC DNT students
text:
- Top class college: the benefit is not given to more than 2 siblings in a family.
- A student cannot hold another scholarship for the same purpose at the same time and must choose one.
- Post-matric: seats filled through management quota, NRI quota or spot admission are not eligible.
- Post-matric: a second course at the same level in another subject (for example B.Com after B.A.) is not covered.

title: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs and Others (PM YASASVI) (PM YASASVI) — Benefits
aliases: Top Class Education for OBC EBC DNT students
text:
- Pre-matric (Class 9-10): Rs 4,000 a year as an academic allowance.
- Post-matric: Rs 20,000 a year for Group 1 professional degree and PG courses (Rs 10,000 academic allowance plus Rs 10,000 tuition fee), Rs 13,000 for Group 2 other professional courses, Rs 8,000 for Group 3 general degrees such as BA, BSc and BCom, and Rs 5,000 for Group 4 non-degree courses after Class 10 such as Class 11-12.
- Top class school: tuition, hostel and other school charges up to Rs 75,000 a year in Class 9-10 and up to Rs 1,25,000 a year in Class 11-12.
- Top class college: full tuition and non-refundable fees (capped at Rs 2.00 lakh a year at private institutions), Rs 3,000 a month for living expenses, Rs 5,000 a year for books and stationery, and a one-time Rs 45,000 for a computer or laptop.
- All payments go directly to the student's bank account (DBT).

title: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs and Others (PM YASASVI) (PM YASASVI) — How to apply
aliases: Top Class Education for OBC EBC DNT students
text:
- Pre-matric and post-matric: apply online on your home state's scholarship portal (or the National Scholarship Portal where the state uses it), ideally on the day of admission; renewal is automatic after promotion with at least 75% attendance.
- Post-matric: eligible students can get a Freeship Card from the state portal so they can take admission without paying tuition and hostel fees in advance.
- Top class school and top class college: apply on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in); the school or institute verifies the application, and students must apply again every year for renewal.
- For academic year 2026-27, the top class school and college parts opened on NSP on 1 June 2026 and close for students on 31 October 2026.

title: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs and Others (PM YASASVI) (PM YASASVI) — Documents needed
aliases: Top Class Education for OBC EBC DNT students
text:
- OBC, EBC or DNT category certificate.
- Income certificate (needed once, at admission).
- Aadhaar number (authentication is compulsory at renewal if not given earlier).
- Bank account in the student's name.
- Marksheets of previous exams; for top class college, admission rank and fee details.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) — Overview
text:
PMAY-G gives money to poor rural families who have no house or live in a kutcha house so they can build a pucca house. The grant is Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hill, north-eastern and difficult areas. The scheme is still running: its second phase adds 2 crore more houses, and the overall target is 4.95 crore houses by March 2029.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Rural Development (Department of Rural Development).

title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) — Eligibility rules
text:
- You must live in a rural area (a village).
- Your household has no house, or lives in a kutcha house.
- Your present house has no more than 2 rooms.
- No member of your household owns a pucca house.
- Families are chosen from the SECC 2011 housing-deprivation data and the Awaas+ survey lists, and the Gram Sabha checks the list.
- These families get top priority (automatic inclusion): those with no shelter, destitute families living on alms, manual scavengers, Primitive Tribal Group families and legally freed bonded labourers.
Not eligible:
- Anyone in the household owns a motorised three-wheeler or four-wheeler, or mechanised three- or four-wheeler farm equipment.
- Anyone in the household has a Kisan Credit Card with a limit of Rs 50,000 or more.
- Any household member is a government employee, or the household runs a non-farm business registered with the government.
- Any household member earns more than Rs 15,000 a month.
- Anyone in the household pays income tax or professional tax.
- The household owns 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land, or 5 acres or more of unirrigated land.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) — Benefits
text:
- Rs 1.20 lakh to build a pucca house in plain areas.
- Rs 1.30 lakh in hill states and UTs (Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh), North-Eastern states, difficult areas and IAP districts.
- Up to 90/95 days of unskilled wage work under MGNREGS for building your own house, on top of the grant.
- Rs 12,000 for a toilet, through Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen), MGNREGS or another funding source.
- The house must be at least 25 square metres, with a space for clean cooking. Officials also help with house designs and trained masons.
- If you want one, officials help you get a bank loan of up to Rs 70,000. All payments go by DBT into your Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) — How to apply
text:
- You cannot just fill in a form. Households are picked from the SECC 2011 and Awaas+ lists, which the Gram Sabha verifies and puts into a Permanent Wait List.
- New households were added through the Awaas+ 2024 Android app, either by a self-survey with Aadhaar face authentication or through a surveyor assigned to the Gram Panchayat.
- Ask your Gram Panchayat or block office about your status. The Permanent Wait List and beneficiary details can be checked on pmayg.dord.gov.in.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar of the chosen beneficiary, for face-authentication e-KYC in the Awaas+ 2024 survey.
- Aadhaar numbers and mobile numbers of all household members.
- MGNREGA job card, which is checked before the list goes to the Gram Sabha.
- Bank account details. These are optional at the survey stage because payments can go through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) — Overview
text:
PMAY-U 2.0 helps urban families who own no pucca house anywhere in India and earn up to Rs 9 lakh a year to build, buy or rent a home. Poorer (EWS) families can get about Rs 2.5 lakh of government help per house, and home-loan borrowers can get an interest subsidy of up to Rs 1.80 lakh. It runs for 5 years from 1 September 2024.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) — Eligibility rules (part 1 of 2)
text:
- Your family lives in an urban area (a statutory town or a notified planning or development area).
- No member of your family owns a pucca house anywhere in India.
- Your annual household income is up to Rs 9 lakh (Rs 9,00,000). EWS means up to Rs 3 lakh, LIG means Rs 3 lakh to Rs 6 lakh, and MIG means Rs 6 lakh to Rs 9 lakh.
- 'Family' means husband, wife and unmarried sons and/or unmarried daughters.
- Only EWS families (income up to Rs 3 lakh) can get help to build a house on their own land (BLC) or to own a house in a partnership project (AHP). For BLC you need your own land or a land patta from the state.
- The home-loan interest subsidy (ISS) is for EWS, LIG and MIG families. The loan must be up to Rs 25 lakh, the house worth up to Rs 35 lakh and the carpet area up to 120 sq m, and the loan must be sanctioned and paid out on or after 1 September 2024.
- Every family member must have Aadhaar or an Aadhaar Virtual ID.
Not eligible:
- You cannot apply if you were given a house under any Central, State or local government housing scheme in the last 20 years, in a town or a village.
- You cannot apply if your family owns a pucca house anywhere in India.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) — Eligibility rules (part 2 of 2)
text:
- Families whose PMAY-U houses were cancelled (curtailed) after 31 December 2023 cannot get them sanctioned again under PMAY-U 2.0.
- No interest subsidy if the loan is above Rs 25 lakh or the house is worth more than Rs 35 lakh.
- No interest subsidy if an earlier owner already took the subsidy on the same property, or if you claim it again after moving your loan to another lender.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) — Benefits
text:
- Building your own house (BLC) or a house in a partnership project (AHP): in most states you get Rs 1.5 lakh from the Centre plus at least Rs 1 lakh from the State, so Rs 2.5 lakh in all.
- In North-Eastern states, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Jammu and Kashmir, Puducherry and Delhi, the Centre pays Rs 2.25 lakh and the State at least Rs 0.25 lakh. In other UTs the Centre pays Rs 2.50 lakh.
- BLC money is paid by DBT in 3 instalments (40:40:20) as building work goes ahead. The house must be 30 to 45 sq m.
- Home loans (ISS): you get a 4% interest subsidy on the first Rs 8 lakh of the loan, for up to 12 years. The maximum is Rs 1.80 lakh, paid in 5 yearly instalments into your loan account.
- Rental housing (ARH): affordable rented homes and dormitories for urban poor, working women, industrial workers and other EWS/LIG families.
- The house is put in the name of the woman head of the family, or jointly with her husband. It cannot be sold or transferred for 5 years.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) — How to apply
text:
- Apply online on the PMAY-U 2.0 Unified Web Portal (pmaymis.gov.in, 'Apply for PMAY-U 2.0'), which first checks whether you are eligible.
- You can also apply at a Common Service Centre (CSC), or directly at your Urban Local Body or municipality.
- For the home-loan subsidy, register on the portal. Your application is sent to your bank or housing finance company.
- The ULB or State checks your eligibility, and a district- or ULB-level committee picks the beneficiaries.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar card. Every family member must have Aadhaar.
- Bank account details.
- Income certificate. For the home-loan subsidy, a self-certificate or affidavit of income is accepted.
- An undertaking in the official format saying you meet the income limit and own no pucca house.
- For building on your own land (BLC): proof that you own the land.
- Proof of a preference group (for example SC/ST) only if you claim priority. A caste certificate is not compulsory.

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) — Overview
text:
A bank loan with a government subsidy to set up a new micro enterprise in manufacturing, service or business. The subsidy is 15% to 35% of the project cost depending on category and area, and there is a second loan with subsidy to upgrade existing units. It was approved up to 2025-26; whether it continues from April 2026 could not be confirmed.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (implemented by Khadi and Village Industries Commission).

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Any individual above 18 years of age can apply.
- There is no income limit.
- For projects costing above Rs 10 lakh in manufacturing, or above Rs 5 lakh in business/service, you must have passed at least Class VIII (8th standard).
- Help is only for new projects sanctioned specifically under PMEGP.
- Only one person per family can get help to set up a project; family means self and spouse.
- For an upgradation (second) loan: the first PMEGP, REGP or MUDRA loan must have been repaid on time, the earlier subsidy adjusted after the 3-year lock-in, and the unit must be making a profit.
Not eligible:
- Existing units set up under PMRY, REGP or any other central or state government scheme cannot apply for a new-unit subsidy.
- Units that have already received a government subsidy under any other central or state scheme are not eligible.
- Projects with no capital expenditure are not financed.
- Activities on the scheme's negative list, or banned by local authorities, are not allowed.
- The cost of land cannot be counted in the project cost.

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) — Benefits
text:
- Margin money subsidy for General category: 15% of project cost in urban areas and 25% in rural areas.
- Special category (SC, ST, OBC, minorities, women, ex-servicemen, transgender persons, persons with disabilities, North-East region, Aspirational Districts, hill and border areas): 25% in urban areas and 35% in rural areas.
- Your own contribution is 10% of the project cost for General category and 5% for Special category; the bank lends the rest.
- Subsidy applies to project cost up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for business/service units; banks may lend above this without subsidy.
- A second loan to upgrade an existing PMEGP, REGP or MUDRA unit gets 15% subsidy (20% in North-East and hill states), up to Rs 15 lakh for manufacturing (project up to Rs 1 crore) and Rs 3.75 lakh for service (project up to Rs 25 lakh), or Rs 20 lakh and Rs 5 lakh in North-East and hill states.
- Banks do not ask for collateral on loans up to Rs 20 lakh; the bank charges its normal interest rate, and the subsidy is kept in the beneficiary's name for 3 years before being adjusted.

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) — How to apply
text:
- Apply online only, on the PMEGP portal run by KVIC; paper applications are not accepted.
- Aadhaar is mandatory and is checked with UIDAI when you file the application.
- The implementing agency (KVIC, State Khadi and Village Industries Board or District Industries Centre) checks the application and sends it to the bank you choose.
- You must complete Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training before the bank releases the loan, unless you already did at least 10 days (offline) or 60 hours (online) of EDP or skill training.

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar number.
- Photograph.
- Project report.
- Caste certificate or special category certificate, where needed.
- Rural area certificate, for a unit in a rural area.
- Education, EDP or skill training certificate.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) — Overview
text:
Crop insurance for farmers, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers, who grow notified crops in notified areas. The farmer pays a small premium (at most 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi and 5% for commercial or horticultural crops) and is paid for crop loss caused by natural calamities, pests and diseases.
Central government scheme. Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) — Eligibility rules (part 1 of 2)
text:
- Any farmer growing a notified crop in a notified area can be insured, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers.
- The farmer must have an insurable interest in the crop and land, shown by land records (such as RoR or LPC) or a tenancy or sharecropping agreement accepted by the State.
- Tribal farmers and forest dwellers cultivating forest land under the Forest Rights Act can also be insured.
- Joining is voluntary for all farmers, including those who have a Kisan Credit Card or crop loan.
- Farmers with a KCC or crop loan for a notified crop are enrolled through their bank automatically unless they opt out in writing at least 7 days before the enrolment cut-off date.
- The farmer must give an Aadhaar number and declare the crop sown or to be sown.
- Enrolment must be done before the cut-off date notified by the State, which normally is not later than 15 July for Kharif, 15 December for Rabi and 15 February for summer crops.
Not eligible:
- Losses caused by war, nuclear risks, malicious damage or other preventable risks are not covered.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) — Eligibility rules (part 2 of 2)
text:
- A loan taken only against gold, fixed deposits or other collateral, without insurable interest in notified land and crop, does not qualify for cover.
- Farmers who enrol, or whose premium is debited, after the damaging event has happened cannot claim localized calamity loss for that event.
- Crops that the State has not notified for that area and season are not covered.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) — Benefits
text:
- For Kharif food grain and oilseed crops, the farmer pays at most 2% of the sum insured as premium (or the actuarial rate if lower).
- For Rabi food grain and oilseed crops, the farmer pays at most 1.5% of the sum insured as premium.
- For annual commercial and horticultural crops, the farmer pays at most 5% of the sum insured as premium.
- The rest of the premium is paid by the Centre and the State, shared 50:50, or 90:10 in Himalayan and North-Eastern States.
- Basic cover pays for yield loss of standing crops from sowing to harvest due to drought, dry spells, flood, inundation, pests and diseases, landslides, fire from lightning, storm, hailstorm and cyclone.
- Where the State notifies them, extra covers include prevented sowing, mid-season adversity, localized calamities, and post-harvest loss for up to 14 days for crops left to dry in the field.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) — How to apply
text:
- Farmers with a KCC or crop loan are enrolled through their bank branch or PACS; they may opt out by giving a written declaration at least 7 days before the cut-off date.
- Other farmers can apply at a bank branch, a Common Service Centre (CSC), through an authorised insurance intermediary, or themselves on the National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in) or the Crop Insurance App.
- Apply and pay the premium before the cut-off date notified by your State for the crop and season.
- Report crop loss from hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloud burst or lightning fire within 72 hours through the Crop Insurance App, the Krishi Rakshak Portal and Helpline, the insurance company's toll-free number, your bank or local agriculture officials.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) — Documents needed
text:
- Land record such as Record of Rights (RoR) or Land Possession Certificate (LPC).
- For tenant farmers and sharecroppers, the contract or agreement or other document notified by the State.
- Aadhaar number.
- Bank account details (account number and IFSC) for receiving claims.
- Declaration of the crop sown or intended to be sown, with area.

title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Overview
text:
Offers paid internships of 6 or 9 months in top companies to Indian youth aged 18 to 25 who are not in full-time jobs. Interns get Rs 9,000 a month, a one-time grant of Rs 6,000 and insurance cover. It is still a pilot project, extended until December 2026, and applications are taken on a rolling basis.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Eligibility rules (part 1 of 2)
text:
- Must be an Indian national.
- Aged 18 to 25 years on the date the application is submitted.
- Must not be in a full-time job.
- Must have passed Class 10 (High School) or Class 12, or hold an ITI certificate or a polytechnic diploma, or a graduate degree (such as BA, B.Sc., B.Com, BCA, BBA, B.Pharma, B.E./B.Tech) or a postgraduate degree (such as MA, M.Sc., M.Com, MCA, M.Tech).
- Must not be in full-time education; however, people in online or distance courses, and final-year full-time graduate or postgraduate students, can apply.
- Final-year students must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their institution confirming the internship will not affect their studies.
Not eligible:
- Graduates or postgraduates of IITs, IIMs, National Law Universities, IISER, NIDs, IIITs and IISc.
- Holders of CA, CMA, CS, MBBS, BDS, MD, MS, MBA (or equivalent), MPhil or PhD.
- Anyone currently in a skill, apprenticeship, internship or training programme under a Central or State Government scheme, or who has ever completed apprenticeship or training under NATS or NAPS.

title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Eligibility rules (part 2 of 2)
text:
- Anyone whose own income, or the income of a parent or spouse, was more than Rs 12 lakh (Rs 12,00,000) in the previous financial year.
- Anyone who, or whose parent or spouse, is a permanent or regular government employee (Central or State Government, UT administration, PSU, statutory body or local body); contractual employees do not count.

title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Benefits
text:
- Rs 9,000 a month for the whole internship: Rs 900 from the company and Rs 8,100 from the government, paid by DBT into the intern's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
- A one-time grant of Rs 6,000 for incidental costs, paid by DBT in two parts of Rs 3,000: the first within 15 days of joining and the second within 15 days of completing 3 months.
- Life and personal accident insurance cover equal to PMJJBY and PMSBY, provided by the government; companies may add extra accident cover.
- The internship lasts either 6 or 9 months depending on the company and role, and at least half of it is spent in actual work, not in a classroom.
- The company's Rs 900 share may be reduced in line with the intern's attendance, and the government share is adjusted to match.

title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) — How to apply
text:
- Register on the PMIS portal (pminternship.mca.gov.in) or the PMIS mobile app with your Aadhaar-linked mobile number and complete e-KYC (for example through DigiLocker).
- Fill in your profile, education and bank details; the portal creates a resume for you.
- Browse internships by state, district, sector, role and qualification, and apply; applications are open on a rolling basis during the pilot.
- Shortlisted applications go to companies, which select interns and send offers; accept your offer on the portal.

title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar card.
- Educational certificates.
- Proof of age.
- Details of a bank account seeded with Aadhaar, for DBT payments.
- For final-year students: an NOC from the institution signed by the Head of Department, Dean, Principal or Training & Placement Officer.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) — Overview
text:
A national mission that helps people with no bank account open a basic savings account with no minimum balance. Account holders get a free RuPay debit card with accident insurance, and eligible holders can get an overdraft of up to Rs 10,000. The scheme started on 28 August 2014 and is still open.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Any Indian citizen who is eligible to open an ordinary bank account can open a basic savings account under the scheme.
- The account is meant for people who do not already have a bank account.
- Since 2018 the scheme aims to reach every adult without a bank account, not just one account per household.
- The overdraft facility is only for account holders aged 18 to 65 years.
- An overdraft of up to Rs 2,000 has no conditions attached; for larger amounts the bank looks at how the account has been run, usually over 6 months.
Not eligible:
- Account holders younger than 18 or older than 65 cannot get the overdraft.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) — Benefits
text:
- A basic savings bank account with no minimum balance requirement, and interest on the money deposited.
- A free RuPay debit card.
- Accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh through the RuPay card for accounts opened after 28 August 2018 (Rs 1 lakh for accounts opened before that date).
- An overdraft of up to Rs 10,000 for eligible account holders.
- The account can receive Direct Benefit Transfers and can be used to join PMJJBY, PMSBY, Atal Pension Yojana and MUDRA loans.
- To claim the RuPay accident cover, the card should have been used for at least one transaction in the 90 days before the accident, and the claim should be reported to the bank within 90 days of the accident.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) — How to apply
text:
- Go to any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra) outlet and ask to open a Jan Dhan account.
- Fill in the PMJDY account opening form, available in English and Hindi on pmjdy.gov.in.
- For help, call the national toll-free numbers 1800 11 0001 or 1800 180 1111.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) — Documents needed
text:
- If you have an Aadhaar card or Aadhaar number, no other document is needed.
- Without Aadhaar, any one officially valid document such as a voter ID card, driving licence, PAN card, passport or NREGA job card.
- With no documents at all, a small account (chhota khata) can be opened. It is valid for 12 months and can be extended by another 12 months if you show you have applied for an officially valid document.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) — Overview
text:
A one-year life insurance cover, renewed every year, for bank or post office account holders who join between ages 18 and 50. It pays Rs 2 lakh to the family if the insured person dies from any cause, for a premium of Rs 436 a year taken automatically from the account.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Aged 18 to 50 years when joining.
- Holds an individual or joint savings account with a participating bank or post office.
- Agrees to join and allows the yearly premium to be auto-debited from that account.
- A person can join through only one bank or post office account.
- A member who joined before turning 50 can keep renewing the cover every year up to age 55.
Not eligible:
- New entry is not allowed after the age of 50 years.
- Cover ends on reaching age 55 (age nearest birthday).
- Cover ends if the bank account is closed or does not have enough balance to pay the premium.
- Death from causes other than an accident within the first 30 days of joining is not covered.
- If premium is paid through more than one account, the extra premium is forfeited and total cover stays at Rs 2 lakh.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) — Benefits
text:
- Rs 2 lakh is paid to the nominee if the insured person dies from any cause.
- The premium is Rs 436 a year, auto-debited from the account in one instalment.
- Cover lasts one year, from 1 June to 31 May, and is renewed every year.
- First-time members joining mid-year pay less: Rs 436 in June to August, Rs 342 in September to November, Rs 228 in December to February and Rs 114 in March to May.
- Accidental death is covered from the first day, and this cover is in addition to any other insurance the person has.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) — How to apply
text:
- Go to the bank branch or post office where you have your savings account and submit the scheme form with your consent for auto-debit.
- The premium is taken automatically each year on or before 31 May. If you drop out, you can rejoin later by paying the premium, but the 30-day waiting period for non-accidental death applies again.
- Claims are made through the bank or post office where the member is enrolled, and are settled by LIC or the other life insurer running the cover.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) — Documents needed
text:
- A savings account with a participating bank or post office.
- The filled scheme enrolment form with consent for auto-debit of the premium.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0) — Overview
text:
Gives free, government-certified skill training (Short-Term Training) and certifies skills people already have (Recognition of Prior Learning) for Indians aged 15 to 59. You find and join batches through the Skill India Digital Hub. Its approved period ended in March 2026 and it was extended for a limited time to 30 September 2026, so check that batches are still open.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Must be an Indian national with a valid Aadhaar.
- Overall, PMKVY 4.0 is meant for people aged 15 to 59 years.
- Short-Term Training is for people aged 15 to 45 years.
- Short-Term Training mainly targets school or college dropouts and unemployed youth.
- Must have an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
- Must meet the entry conditions (such as education) set for the chosen job role.
- For Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), you must already have the work experience in that job role that is specified for it.
Not eligible:
- People younger than 15 cannot join.
- People older than 45 cannot join Short-Term Training.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0) — Benefits
text:
- Training, assessment and certification are free of cost for eligible candidates.
- Candidates who pass get a certificate mapped to the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF), which is linked with DigiLocker.
- Short-term courses include on-the-job training at a real workplace.
- Women, persons with disabilities and candidates in special areas (such as aspirational, border, tribal and Left Wing Extremism-affected districts) get support for boarding, lodging and travel; these special groups also get conveyance support in non-residential training.
- Training providers get up to Rs 5,000 per candidate with a disability to buy assistive devices and aids.
- Short micro-credential courses of 7.5 to 30 hours are also offered.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0) — How to apply
text:
- Open the PMKVY page on Skill India Digital Hub (skillindiadigital.gov.in/pmkvy-landing) and click 'Show Interest'.
- Complete Aadhaar e-KYC and your profile, then browse and register for a training batch near you.
- You can also contact the nearest PMKVY training centre.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0) — Documents needed
text:
- Aadhaar card (Aadhaar e-KYC is needed to register).
- Details of an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
- Documents showing you meet the job role's entry conditions, such as education certificates.
- For RPL, proof of prior work experience in the job role, as specified for that role.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) — Overview
text:
A fisheries scheme that pays up to 40% of the cost of approved fish farming and fisheries projects for general category beneficiaries and up to 60% for SC, ST and women. It also gives livelihood support and accident insurance to fishers. The original scheme period was 2020-21 to 2024-25, so check with your State fisheries department whether new applications are open.
Central government scheme. Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) — Eligibility rules (part 1 of 2)
text:
- Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers and fish vendors can apply as individuals.
- Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, women and differently abled persons are listed beneficiaries; SC, ST and women get the higher rate of assistance.
- Self Help Groups, Joint Liability Groups, fisheries cooperatives, Fish Farmer Producer Organisations, and entrepreneurs or private firms can also apply.
- The project must be a beneficiary-oriented activity listed under the scheme and backed by a Detailed Project Report or self-contained proposal.
- The applicant must already have the land or water body, owned or on lease; a land lease should normally be at least 10 years for infrastructure projects and 7 years for other projects.
- For livelihood support during the fishing ban, the person must be a full-time active traditional fisher, below the poverty line, aged 18 to 60, and a member of a fishers' cooperative or other registered body.
Not eligible:
- No assistance is given for buying, leasing or acquiring land.
- A project that already gets central funding for the same work in the same location is not funded again.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) — Eligibility rules (part 2 of 2)
text:
- If the beneficiary ends the lease early or transfers the assets before the lease period ends, all central assistance must be paid back with 12% yearly penal interest.
- Proposals that are not viable or lack land, clearances or permissions are rejected, and their preparation costs are not reimbursed.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) — Benefits
text:
- General category beneficiaries get government assistance of up to 40% of the project or unit cost.
- SC, ST and women beneficiaries get government assistance of up to 60% of the project or unit cost.
- The beneficiary pays the rest from own money or a bank loan; for example, on a Rs 1 lakh project the government pays at most Rs 40,000 for general category and Rs 60,000 for SC, ST and women.
- Each activity has a unit cost ceiling; Himalayan, North-Eastern and island areas may get up to 20% higher unit costs.
- Livelihood and nutritional support in the fishing ban or lean period: the fisher saves Rs 1,500 a year, the government adds Rs 3,000, and the total of Rs 4,500 is paid at Rs 1,500 a month.
- Accident insurance for fishers with the full premium paid by government: Rs 5 lakh for death or permanent total disability, Rs 2.5 lakh for permanent partial disability and Rs 25,000 for accidental hospitalisation.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) — How to apply
text:
- Contact your district fisheries officer or the State/UT Department of Fisheries, which is the nodal department for the scheme.
- Prepare a Detailed Project Report with cost estimate, proof of land or water body, sources of funds (own money or bank loan consent) and a timeline.
- Projects are put in the district fisheries plan by the District Level Committee and approved by the State Level Approval and Monitoring Committee before central approval; assistance is usually released in two instalments.
- Some States publish PMMSY application forms on their fisheries department websites (for example, the Goa Directorate of Fisheries).

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) — Documents needed
text:
- Detailed Project Report (DPR) or self-contained proposal.
- Proof of land or water body ownership, or a registered lease.
- Certificate that the land is free from encroachments and encumbrances.
- Statutory clearances, permits and licences where required.
- Undertaking that no other government assistance is taken for the same project.
- Aadhaar card (stated as mandatory for replacement boats and nets for traditional fishermen).

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) — Overview
text:
PMMVY gives cash to pregnant women and new mothers from disadvantaged groups. They get Rs 5,000 in two instalments for the first child, and Rs 6,000 in one instalment if the second child is a girl. The money is paid straight into the woman's Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Women and Child Development.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Open to pregnant women and breastfeeding mothers.
- The woman must be between 18 years 7 months and 55 years old when the child is born.
- She must belong to at least one listed disadvantaged group: SC or ST, disabled (40% or more), BPL ration card, NFSA ration card, Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, e-Shram card, PM Kisan farmer, or MGNREGA job card.
- A net family income below Rs 8 lakh a year also counts as a qualifying group, even if none of the other groups apply.
- Pregnant or breastfeeding Anganwadi workers, Anganwadi helpers and ASHAs also qualify.
- The benefit covers the first child, and also the second child if the second child is a girl.
- For the second-child benefit, the pregnancy must be registered before delivery. The rules apply to births from 1 April 2022.
- The woman needs an Aadhaar number and a bank or post office account linked to Aadhaar.
Not eligible:
- Women with regular jobs in the Central Government, a State Government or a public sector undertaking cannot apply.
- Women who already get similar maternity benefits under another law cannot apply.
- There is no payment if the second child is a boy, and none for a third or later child.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) — Benefits
text:
- First child: Rs 5,000 in two instalments.
- First instalment of Rs 3,000 once the pregnancy is registered and at least one ante-natal check-up is done within 6 months of the last menstrual period.
- Second instalment of Rs 2,000 once the birth is registered and the baby has had the first round of vaccines (BCG, OPV, DPT and Hepatitis-B), which are due by 14 weeks.
- Second child who is a girl: Rs 6,000 in one instalment after the birth, once she has had all vaccines due up to 14 weeks.
- If the second pregnancy gives twins or more and at least one baby is a girl, the second-girl benefit is paid.
- After a miscarriage or stillbirth, the woman counts as a new beneficiary in her next pregnancy.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) — How to apply
text:
- Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre or approved health facility. The Anganwadi worker or ASHA can fill in the form online on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
- You can also register yourself on the PMMVY portal or the PMMVY mobile app.
- Apply within 270 days of the child's birth. For the second girl child, the pregnancy must be registered before delivery.
- Since 21 May 2025, every new enrolment needs face authentication. For help, call the PMMVY helpline 1515.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) — Documents needed
text:
- The woman's Aadhaar card.
- A bank or post office account linked to Aadhaar.
- The Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card or RCH card.
- Proof of one eligibility group, for example a caste certificate, ration card, e-Shram card, MGNREGA job card, Ayushman card or income certificate.
- For the later payment, the child's birth registration and vaccination record.
- A mobile number.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) — Overview
text:
Loans without collateral for micro enterprises doing non-farm business, or allied activities such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping. Banks, NBFCs and microfinance institutions give the loans in four categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (up to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (up to Rs 10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (up to Rs 20 lakh, for those who repaid a Tarun loan).
Central government scheme. Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) — Eligibility rules
text:
- Meant for micro enterprises (small businesses) that need institutional credit.
- The loan must be for a non-agricultural activity; allied activities such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping are also covered.
- The loan can be for a term loan, working capital, or both.
- Tarun Plus loans (above Rs 10 lakh) are only for entrepreneurs who took and fully repaid an earlier loan under the Tarun category.
Not eligible:
- Farming itself is not covered; the loan is for non-agricultural purposes and allied activities only.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) — Benefits
text:
- Shishu: loan of up to Rs 50,000.
- Kishore: loan above Rs 50,000 and up to Rs 5 lakh.
- Tarun: loan above Rs 5 lakh and up to Rs 10 lakh.
- Tarun Plus: loan above Rs 10 lakh and up to Rs 20 lakh, available from 24 October 2024 to those who repaid an earlier Tarun loan.
- No collateral (security) is required.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) — How to apply
text: - Apply at a member lending institution: a public sector bank, private sector bank, foreign bank, Regional Rural Bank, Small Finance Bank, NBFC, or microfinance institution (MFI or NBFC-MFI).

title: Post Matric Scholarship to the Students belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (PMS-SC) — Overview
aliases: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students
text:
A centrally sponsored scholarship for Scheduled Caste students studying after Class 10 (from Class 11 up to PhD) whose parents earn up to Rs 2.5 lakh a year. It pays the compulsory non-refundable fees, including tuition, plus a yearly academic allowance of Rs 2,500 to Rs 13,500. The student's home State/UT runs it.
Central government scheme. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.

title: Post Matric Scholarship to the Students belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (PMS-SC) — Eligibility rules
aliases: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students
text:
- You must be an Indian national.
- You must belong to a Scheduled Caste notified for the State/UT where you are domiciled.
- You must have passed Class 10 (matriculation) or a higher exam from a recognised board or university.
- Parents' or guardian's income from all sources must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 in the last financial year.
- You must study a recognised post-matric course (Class 11-12, ITI, diploma, graduation, postgraduation, PhD etc.) at a recognised institution in India.
- All children of the same parents can get the scholarship; there is no limit on the number of children.
- To keep getting it each year, you need satisfactory academic performance and at least 75% attendance.
Not eligible:
- Students admitted on management quota, NRI quota, spot admission or other seats not filled on merit.
- Students who finish one stage and then study the same stage again in another subject, e.g. B.Com after B.A.
- Students who accept another scholarship or stipend at the same time; they must choose one.
- Studies abroad are not covered.
- Students who got the scholarship through false statements are blacklisted from all scholarships.

title: Post Matric Scholarship to the Students belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (PMS-SC) — Benefits
aliases: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students
text:
- Full compulsory non-refundable fees, including tuition fee, as fixed by the State fee fixation committee. Refundable deposits are not covered.
- Group 1 (professional degree and PG courses such as medicine, engineering, management, law, MPhil/PhD): Rs 13,500 a year for hostellers and Rs 7,000 for day scholars.
- Group 2 (other professional courses such as B.Pharma, B.Nursing, hotel management, and diplomas entered after Class 12): Rs 9,500 a year for hostellers and Rs 6,500 for day scholars.
- Group 3 (general degrees such as BA, BSc, BCom, MA, MSc, MCom): Rs 6,000 a year for hostellers and Rs 3,000 for day scholars.
- Group 4 (non-degree courses entered after Class 10, such as Class 11-12, ITI and polytechnic diplomas): Rs 4,000 a year for hostellers and Rs 2,500 for day scholars.
- Students with disabilities get 10% extra allowance. Students in correspondence or online courses get only the fees, with no academic allowance.

title: Post Matric Scholarship to the Students belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (PMS-SC) — How to apply
aliases: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students
text:
- Apply on your home State/UT's scholarship portal. The State/UT where you are domiciled selects you and pays the scholarship.
- Before admission, register on the portal for a Freeship Card. It lets you join without paying tuition and hostel fees upfront; you pay the institution within 7 working days of receiving the scholarship.
- Apply for the scholarship on the day of admission; your institution verifies it. Renewal is automatic, based on promotion and attendance.
- The money (Centre's and State's shares) is paid directly into your Aadhaar-linked bank account by DBT.

title: Post Matric Scholarship to the Students belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (PMS-SC) — Documents needed
